name: Oto Audio
description: Oto Audio — a WooCommerce store theme for a hi-fi shop and listening room: a photograph flush to the left window edge with the heading straddling its edge, product cards in a 3:4 trio with round plus buttons, and spec comparison tables in a crosshair frame on ink. White ground, ink bands, one muted brown accent (#6F5A43) on small marks. Newsreader over Public Sans. Works without WooCommerce.

fonts.role: display headings, product names, wordmark (variable 300-600, Latin subset)
text: body, labels, navigation, prices (variable, Latin subset)
fonts.copyright: Copyright 2015 The Public Sans Project Authors

summary.en: A hi-fi shop: left-bleed photograph with a straddling heading, 3:4 product trio and comparison tables in a crosshair frame on ink.
